item.title: [No Priors] Beam: The Great American Open Model with ReflectionAI Co-Founder and CEO Misha Laskin
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:26 When you remove cyber offensive capabilities, you also remove cyber defensive capabilities. The state of the world today is that we have a few 100 safety researchers within closed labs that understand how these things work. And despite their best intentions, is impossible to cover the long tail of unintended consequences that these systems might have.
